headline: SAQUON BARKLEY SCORED 1.50 AND VANGMUSHU IS THE LEAGUE'S LAST 0-4 🪦

sections.heading: CVANG1990 DIDN'T WIN, HE ANNEXED 💣
sections.body:
147.73 to 85.22. Sixty-two and a half points. ChunckyM — the man who dropped 152.02 in Week 2 and spent a week being insufferable about it — started George Holani for 2.50 and Parker Washington for 1.50 and got turned into a highlight reel.

UnderDogStyle now leads the league in points scored at 472.33 and sits at 3-1. The nickname is no longer accurate and should be reviewed by the commissioner. LOL. 🐕

sections.heading: TETAIROA McMILLAN WENT 38.20 FOR A TEAM THAT WAS 0-3 🎯
sections.body:
Best individual performance of Week 4, and it belonged to the only winless team in the league. muahuavang finally got one, 139.56 to jayvang100's 117.30, behind McMillan's 38.20, Nico Collins' 27.30 and — sincerely, write this down — Bryce Young's 25.46.

Ulysseus also left only 15.80 points on the bench, second-leanest in the league. Turns out when you're 0-3 you stop experimenting and just start the good players. Revolutionary stuff. 🧪

The Kelce asterisk: Travis Kelce started and produced 2.50. Even the first win of the season comes with a receipt. 🧾

sections.heading: TWO POINTS AND FIVE CENTS ⏱️
sections.body:
Evz132 102.37, Tonglue 100.32. The closest game of the week was decided by 2.05, and the margin was effectively one kicker: Will Reichard's 19.00 was the best kicker score in the league and the second-best player on I am DOOM's entire roster.

Tonglue, meanwhile, benched Emanuel Wilson's 25.50. Twenty-five and a half points. The game was lost by two. DarkHado left 41.10 on the bench and lost by less than a field goal, which is the kind of thing you think about at 3 a.m. for the rest of the season. ☠️

sections.heading: KIRK COUSINS LED A FIRST-PLACE TEAM, LOL 🧟
sections.body:
In the year of our lord 2026, Kirk Cousins scored 26.60 and was the highest scorer on a 3-1 roster. Christian McCaffrey, on that same roster, managed 14.50.

KevinVang also left 55.00 points on his bench — the most of anyone this week, including Brian Robinson's 25.20 — and still beat YMVtheDAD by 3.48. Michelob Plus Ultra is 3-1 with the fourth-worst bench management in the league and the best vibes. Don't explain it. Don't look at it directly. 🍺

sections.heading: NOBODY SPENT A DOLLAR: THE KICKER CAROUSEL 🎠
sections.body:
Fourteen transactions in Week 4 and not one FAAB bid among them. Zero dollars. The entire league rummaged through free agency like a yard sale.

It mostly worked. imbackbeech signed Matt Gay and got 16.00 — more than Ja'Marr Chase, Saquon Barkley and DJ Moore COMBINED (7.90, for the record). Hvang94 picked up the Cardinals defense for 9.00. mouavang86 swapped Tyler Bass for Nick Folk and banked 9.00. ChunckyM cycled kickers to land on Eddy Pineiro's 5.00, which is less a move than a lateral shuffle.

Special recognition to Hvang94, who dropped Bo Nix for Joe Mixon, then re-signed Bo Nix two moves later, then benched him for 15.56. A full week of roster churn to arrive exactly where he started. 🔁

sections.heading: THE BENCH ALL-STARS ARE UNDEFEATED 🪑
sections.body:
League-wide, 467 points of production watched from the sideline. The honor roll: Kyle Monangai 27.50 (mouavang86, lost by 21.18), Emanuel Wilson 25.50 (Tonglue, lost by 2.05), Brian Robinson 25.20 (KevinVang, won anyway), Brock Purdy 23.62 (jayvang100, lost by 22.26) and Keon Coleman 20.60 (VangMushu, 0-4).

Three of those five bench scores were larger than their manager's margin of defeat. LOL. Set your lineups, people — the league office is begging. 🙏

sections.heading: THE FULL FOURTEEN: EVERYBODY GETS A TURN 🎤
sections.body:
Ranked by what you actually scored in Week 4. Fourteen teams, fourteen verdicts, no hiding behind your record. 📋

1. cvang1990 — 147.73, won by 62.51. Kyren Williams 31.70 and Chuba Hubbard 25.40 is a backfield doing felonies, and Cam Little chipped in 14.00 because even the kicker wanted in. The only blemish: Romeo Doubs went 20.80 in street clothes, outscoring four of your starters, and you still won by sixty. 🏆

2. muahuavang — 139.56, won by 22.26. Tetairoa McMillan's 38.20 was the single best performance in the league this week, Nico Collins added 27.30, and Bryce Young quietly went 25.46 like that's a normal sentence in 2026. First win of the season, and it only took starting Travis Kelce for 2.50 to keep you humble. 🎯

3. Tub89 — 125.68, won by 21.18. CeeDee Lamb 32.80 and C.J. Stroud 27.08 carried a lineup that also contained Dalton Kincaid's 1.20 and Josh Downs' 3.10. Justin Jefferson sat on your bench for a clean 0.00, which is either excellent information or extremely lucky, and nobody will ever know which. 🫡

4. jayvang100 — 117.30, LOST by 22.26. Fourth-highest score in the league and a loss, which is the week's cruelest math. Bijan Robinson went 27.20 and Brock Purdy posted 23.62 from the bench AGAIN — that's four straight weeks of benching your best quarterback, except this is the week it finally cost you the game. Dak gave you 20.10. Purdy gave the folding chair 23.62. 🪑

5. imbackbeech — 112.83, won by 35.41. Javonte Williams 28.80 and a comically lean 11.50 of total bench points, the most efficient lineup in the league. Then there's Ja'Marr Chase, your first-round receiver, with 4.20 — outscored by Matt Gay, a kicker you signed off the street days earlier, by nearly four times. 🦶

6. Hvang94 — 109.98, won by 21.95. Kenneth Walker's 30.40 did most of the work and the Cardinals defense you grabbed off waivers chipped in 9.00. Meanwhile Ollie Gordon went 17.00 on the bench next to Bo Nix's 15.56 — a quarterback you dropped, re-signed, and then benched, all inside one week. "Not good, Just lucky" is doing a lot of load-bearing work at 3-1. 🍀

7. mouavang86 — 104.50, LOST by 21.18. Puka Nacua 23.20 and George Kittle 15.00 showed up, and then Rashee Rice started for a flat 0.00, which is the fantasy equivalent of fielding ten men. Kyle Monangai's 27.50 — the highest bench score in the entire league — would have flipped this game. You lost by 21.18 holding 46.94 bench points. 🎻

8. Evz132 — 102.37, won by 2.05. Survived the closest game of the week by the width of a kicker's ego: Will Reichard's 19.00 was the top kicker score in the league and your second-best starter, behind only Jonathan Taylor's 22.20. DJ Moore contributed 2.20 and DK Metcalf watched from the bench with 14.00. Ugly, narrow, and in the win column. 😮‍💨

9. Tonglue — 100.32, LOST by 2.05. Two points and five cents from a win, with Emanuel Wilson sitting on your bench holding 25.50 — he alone wins this game twelve times over. Add Brenton Strange's benched 13.00 and the 41.10 you left behind, and DarkHado didn't lose this to Evz132 so much as to the roster page. ☠️

10. KevinVang — 97.80, won by 3.48. Kirk Cousins led your team in scoring with 26.60 in the year 2026, which deserves a moment of silence, especially with Christian McCaffrey managing 14.50. You also left 55.00 points on the bench — the most in the league — including Brian Robinson's 25.20, and won anyway. 3-1. Unbelievable. 🧟

11. YMVtheDAD — 94.32, LOST by 3.48. Joe Burrow's 25.72 was real and the rest was a crime scene: Kenyon Sadiq started at tight end for 0.00, the Bills defense managed 0.60, and Dontayvion Wicks added 3.30. Three and a half points short, with a tight end slot that produced literally nothing. Colston Loveland's 8.70 was right there. 💀

12. Keeneng — 88.03, LOST by 21.95. Last week you finally started the correct quarterback and we all applauded. This week Stafford went 9.68 while Trevor Lawrence put up 15.08 on the bench, so the applause is rescinded. Zay Flowers' 21.80 was the lone bright spot, and Courtland Sutton's 0.90 was not. Erling Haaland is 1-3 and allergic to the QB slot. 🙃

13. ChunckyM — 85.22, LOST by 62.51. Two weeks ago you dropped 152.02 and the league was picking up teeth. This week you started George Holani for 2.50 and Parker Washington for 1.50 and got detonated by sixty-two points. Josh Allen's 20.52 and Brock Bowers' 17.60 were the entire roster; Shadow Monarch brought a dagger to a drone strike. 📉

14. VangMushu — 77.42, LOST by 35.41. Saquon Barkley. 1.50 points. A first-round running back producing less than a quarter of your kicker. Sam LaPorta's 18.40 led the team, Keon Coleman went 20.60 from the bench, and Jayden Daniels sat there at 0.00. The team is called "I Chase Brown Kids" and Chase Brown's 13.60 was your second-best starter, so at least the branding is honest. 0-4, lowest points in the league at 338.64. 🪦

sections.heading: FOUR AT 3-1, ONE AT 0-4 📊
sections.body:
A logjam at the top: cvang1990, Tub89, Hvang94 and KevinVang are all 3-1, separated only by points. cvang1990 holds the tiebreak with 472.33, the league's best.

Then seven teams — imbackbeech, jayvang100, ChunckyM, Evz132, YMVtheDAD, mouavang86 and Tonglue — are all 2-2. Half the league is exactly average, which is somehow the most M$G outcome possible.

At the bottom: muahuavang and Keeneng at 1-3, and VangMushu alone at 0-4 with 338.64 points, 63 fewer than anyone else. Spare a thought for mouavang86, who is 2-2 while absorbing 481.24 points against, and for muahuavang, who has faced 513.84 — the worst luck in the league by a mile. 🎢
